source_read: 31 product pages of https://www.greenhalghs.com (the 29 pages with a per-unit calorie line + the 2 per-100 g-only GI loaves) downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (robots.txt checked with robots_rfc: only /wp-admin/ and ?query paths disallowed), the fresh product-sitemap.xml (171 URLs, identical to the earlier saved list), https://www.greenhalghs.com/allergen-information/ and its linked matrix Shop-Allergens-List-QR-Code-V9.pdf (byte-identical to the earlier copy, 'Version 9 / 16/06/2026'); the 140 left-out pages were scanned from the earlier saved copy only
not_verifiable: allergens: none are published per item (link-only: the matrix uses its own codes and names, no verified link to the web shop's products), so there were no allergen values to compare; the 6 'allergen_mismatches' are missed contains_pork tags
notes: Own text extraction (html.parser, not the script's parser) of all 29 pages with a unit line: calories 29/29 equal to items.csv (26 published + the 3 held back), serving wording equal, vegetarian tags equal to 'Suitable for vegetarians/vegans' lines. Fixed in greenhalghs.py: pies whose own ingredient list says Lard (Plate Meat Pie, Beefsteak Pie, Steak Pudding, Potato and Meat Pie, Steak and Ale Pie, Deep Filled Multi Portion Potato & Meat Pie) now carry contains_pork (lard is pig fat; other chains' scripts tag lard the same way); docstring corrected (soups are in the matrix under other codes). The 3 held back (small custards x2, apple slice: per-unit kcal equals the per-100 g kcal) stay held. Set of pages with a unit line unchanged (no missed page); per-unit/per-100 g ratios give plausible unit weights for every page. Re-run reproduces data/source byte for byte; check_chain 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 audit flags.
